products.name: Commercial Real Estate and Multifamily Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate and multifamily properties, including apartment buildings, retail, mixed-use, industrial, manufacturing, and office buildings. Loans are underwritten with robust risk management and are delivered through in-person relationship management and regulated banking infrastructure.

products.name: One-to-Four-Family Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of long-term loans secured by mortgages on primarily owner-occupied, one-to-four-family residences, including both conforming and jumbo loans. Loans are underwritten according to Fannie Mae guidelines and delivered through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Home Equity Loans and Lines of Credit
products.description: Provision of home equity loans and lines of credit secured by the borrower's primary or secondary residence, underwritten using similar criteria as residential mortgages. Delivered through branch and digital channels.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Loans
products.description: Origination of loans for construction and land development, including speculative residential construction and commercial projects, primarily to developers, contractors, and builders. Loans are typically interest-only during construction and require in-person relationship management and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of a broad range of commercial and industrial loans, including lines of credit and term loans, to businesses for working capital and general corporate needs. Delivered through three divisions: Small Business, Middle Market, and Structured Finance, with specialized offerings for industries such as cannabis and solar.

products.name: Mortgage Warehouse Lending
products.description: Provision of master repurchase agreement facilities to independent non-bank mortgage origination companies, allowing them to fund the closing of residential mortgage loans. This is a national platform with relationship managers and is collateralized by underlying mortgages.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offering a variety of consumer loans, including loans secured by deposit accounts, unsecured loans, student loans, home improvement loans, credit cards, and purchased portfolios of auto, recreational vehicle, and boat loans. Delivered through partnerships with third-party originators and direct channels.

products.name: Deposit Accounts
products.description: Offering a selection of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including noninterest-bearing and interest-bearing demand accounts, money market accounts, savings accounts, certificates of deposit, and IRAs. Delivered through branch network and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Provision of cash management products and treasury services to commercial customers, including online banking tools, ACH products, wire capabilities, fraud prevention tools, and customized setups for business cash management. Delivered digitally and managed within the commercial and industrial business unit.

products.name: Regulated Electric Utility Services
products.description: Generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity to residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental customers in Virginia, North Carolina, and South Carolina, delivered via extensive regulated infrastructure including power plants, transmission lines, and distribution networks.

products.name: Wholesale Electricity Sales
products.description: Sale and transmission of electricity at wholesale prices to rural electric cooperatives, municipalities, and into wholesale electricity markets, utilizing regulated and market-based rate authority.

products.name: Utility-Scale Renewable Energy Generation (Wind and Solar)
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of large-scale regulated and nonregulated wind and solar power generation facilities, including offshore wind projects, with output delivered to utility and wholesale customers via long-term contracts or regulated rates.

products.name: Nuclear Power Generation
products.description: Operation of regulated and nonregulated nuclear power plants providing carbon-free baseload electricity, with output sold to utility and wholesale customers; includes management of nuclear fuel supply and decommissioning trusts.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution (South Carolina only)
products.description: Distribution of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in South Carolina via regulated pipeline infrastructure, with rates set by state regulators.

products.name: Battery Energy Storage Services
products.description: Development and operation of utility-scale battery storage facilities to support grid reliability and integration of renewable energy, delivered through regulated utility infrastructure.

products.name: Nonregulated Long-Term Contracted Electric Generation
products.description: Ownership and operation of nonregulated electric generation assets, including renewable and nuclear facilities, with output sold under long-term power purchase agreements to utilities and other large customers.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production
products.description: Production of renewable natural gas by capturing methane from agricultural sources and converting it into pipeline-quality gas, sold to third parties or injected into distribution systems.

products.name: Healthcare Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of healthcare-related real estate properties, primarily skilled nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, independent living facilities, specialty hospitals, and continuing care retirement communities, to third-party operators under long-term triple-net leases. This involves physical real estate assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Healthcare Real Estate Secured Lending
products.description: Provision of mortgage loans and other real estate loans secured by healthcare facilities, including loans for acquisition, construction, and renovation. These are typically collateralized by first, second, or third mortgage liens and require financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Senior Housing Facility Operations (RIDEA Structure)
products.description: Ownership and operation of senior housing facilities (assisted living and independent living) through third-party managers under RIDEA structures, where Omega receives cash flow from facility operations. This involves oversight of facility management and compliance with healthcare regulations, delivered via third-party management agreements.

products.name: Non-Real Estate Lending to Healthcare Operators
products.description: Provision of unsecured or working capital loans to healthcare operators, their principals, or asset purchasers, typically short-term and sometimes secured by operator assets. This is a financial service requiring capital and credit risk management.

products.name: Equity Investments in Healthcare-Related Entities
products.description: Acquisition of equity interests in joint ventures or entities that own or finance healthcare real estate assets or support the long-term healthcare industry. These are minority or controlling stakes, accounted for under the equity method, and involve financial capital and strategic partnerships.

products.name: Dental Technology and Equipment Products
products.description: Manufactured dental equipment and instruments, including imaging systems, dental chairs, treatment centers, handpieces, and lab equipment, delivered physically to dental practitioners and specialists worldwide.

products.name: Dental CAD/CAM Solutions
products.description: Digital dental workflow products such as intraoral scanners, 3D printers, mills, and associated software, enabling same-day or single-visit dentistry, manufactured and delivered as both hardware and cloud-enabled software.

products.name: Dental Consumable Products
products.description: Manufactured endodontic, restorative, and preventive consumables and small equipment for dental procedures, including materials for root canals, restorations, diagnostics, and hygiene, delivered physically to dental professionals.

products.name: Dental Implants and Prosthetics
products.description: Manufactured dental implant systems, digital dentures, crown and bridge products, and related restorative and regenerative solutions, supported by digital workflow and treatment planning software, delivered to dental professionals and labs.

products.name: Orthodontic Solutions (including Clear Aligners)
products.description: Digital orthodontic treatment planning and appliance solutions, including clear aligners, robotically bent wires, retainers, and whitening kits, delivered through cloud-based software and physical products to dental professionals.

products.name: Cloud-Based Dental Software and Digital Services (DS Core)
products.description: Cloud-enabled digital platform and software services for dental workflow integration, treatment planning, diagnostics, and collaboration, delivered digitally to dental professionals and labs.

products.name: Healthcare Consumables for Urology and Enterology (Continence Care Solutions)
products.description: Manufactured medical devices and consumables for urinary and bowel management, including catheters and advanced irrigation systems, delivered physically to distributors, medical providers, and patients.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: A wide range of clothing items for young men and women, sourced from third-party brands and private label, sold through physical stores and ecommerce platforms. Products are manufactured by vendors and foreign manufacturers, and delivered via retail and online channels.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Branded and private label shoes and related footwear products for young men and women, distributed through stores and online, sourced from a broad vendor base and foreign manufacturers.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: A diverse assortment of accessories such as hats, bags, and jewelry, sourced from third-party brands and private label, sold in stores and online, manufactured by vendors and foreign manufacturers.

products.name: Action Sports Hardgoods
products.description: Equipment and gear for action sports, including skateboards, snowboards, bindings, components, and related equipment, sourced from third-party brands and private label, sold through stores and ecommerce. Products require physical manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Dynatrace Platform (SaaS and Managed)
products.description: An integrated, AI-powered observability and application security software platform delivered primarily as a SaaS solution, with an option for customer-managed deployment. It provides monitoring, analytics, automation, and security for applications, infrastructure, and digital experiences across hybrid and multicloud environments.

products.name: Infrastructure Observability
products.description: A software solution within the Dynatrace platform that provides complete visibility into IT infrastructure across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments, enabling monitoring and optimization of infrastructure performance.

products.name: Application Observability
products.description: A software solution that monitors the full application stack, including front-end and back-end technologies, using APM, distributed tracing, and profiling to ensure application performance and reliability.

products.name: AI Observability
products.description: A solution that provides observability for generative AI applications, large language models, and agentic systems, focusing on performance, resilience, explainability, and compliance.

products.name: Digital Experience Monitoring
products.description: A software solution that monitors user experiences across digital channels, including real-user and synthetic monitoring and session replays for mobile and web applications.

products.name: Log Analytics
products.description: A unified log analytics solution that ingests, stores, and analyzes log data for various use cases, with enterprise-grade extensibility and customization, integrated into the Dynatrace platform.

products.name: Application Security
products.description: A software solution that automatically and continuously detects runtime vulnerabilities in applications, libraries, and code, providing near real-time detection and blocking of cyber-attacks.

products.name: Threat Observability
products.description: A solution that uses AI and runtime-enhanced detection to investigate and respond to cybersecurity events within IT environments.

products.name: Software Delivery Automation
products.description: A solution leveraging observability and security data to drive workflow automations for software delivery, using visual workflow creators or automation-as-code.

products.name: Business Analytics
products.description: A solution that unifies data within the Dynatrace platform to provide real-time insights into how digital service performance affects business KPIs and user experiences.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Consulting and implementation services to help customers integrate, automate, and optimize the use of the Dynatrace platform, including cloud ecosystem integration and digital transformation support.

products.name: Endpoint ICs
products.description: Miniature silicon radios-on-a-chip that wirelessly connect and identify items, typically embedded into tags or packaging by OEM partners. Manufactured using semiconductor processes and sold in high volumes for integration into a wide range of products across industries.

products.name: Reader ICs
products.description: Integrated circuits designed for use in embedded or finished RFID readers, enabling wireless discovery, inventory, and engagement of endpoint ICs. Sold to OEM and ODM partners for integration into mobile, handheld, and fixed readers and gateways.

products.name: Finished Readers and Gateways
products.description: High-performance RFID readers and gateways, including devices with beamforming antennas, used for autonomous reading solutions and item tracking. Manufactured by third parties to company specifications and sold through distributors and solution providers.

products.name: Tag Production Systems
products.description: Systems for designing, manufacturing, testing, encoding, and commissioning RFID tags, primarily sold to inlay and tag OEMs and certification bodies. Includes hardware and software for tag production and quality assurance, with some manufacturing performed in-house.

products.name: Software and Cloud Services
products.description: Software and cloud-based services for enterprise solutions enablement, including item resolution, label authentication, and business process automation. Delivered as standalone or bundled offerings, running on readers, gateways, host devices, or in the cloud.

products.name: Intellectual Property Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary intellectual property, including patents and technology related to RAIN RFID and Gen2X protocol enhancements, to partners and industry members. Provides access to unique features and standards compliance for third-party products.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Primis offers a range of commercial loans, including business lines of credit, term loans, equipment loans, SBA loans, and commercial real estate loans, primarily secured by business assets or real estate. These are delivered through in-person relationship management and digital channels, requiring significant underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Through Primis Mortgage Company, the bank originates and sells residential mortgage loans, including new purchase and refinance loans, to consumers nationwide. Loans are originated both for the bank's portfolio and for sale in the secondary market, requiring specialized underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Mortgage Warehouse Lending
products.description: Primis provides warehouse lines of credit to independent mortgage companies, offering short-term funding for residential mortgage originations until the loans are sold in the secondary market. This service is delivered through specialized underwriting and digital monitoring systems.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Primis offers secured and unsecured consumer loans, including home equity lines of credit, personal loans, auto loans, and student loan refinancing, primarily to individuals. These products are delivered through branches and digital platforms, with strict underwriting criteria.

products.name: Healthcare Practice Financing
products.description: Through its Panacea Financial division, Primis provides specialized loans and financial products to medical, dental, and veterinary professionals and their practices, including practice acquisition, equipment financing, and student loan refinancing. Delivery is national, leveraging digital and relationship channels.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Primis offers a broad range of deposit accounts to individuals and businesses, including checking, savings, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, delivered through physical branches and digital platforms. These products are supported by FDIC insurance and digital account management tools.

products.name: Treasury and Cash Management Services
products.description: Primis provides treasury and cash management services to business clients, including investment/sweep accounts, wire transfers, payroll processing, ACH originations, remote deposit capture, and merchant services. These are delivered via digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Primis offers digital banking services, including online and mobile banking for account management, digital account opening, and the V1BE app for on-demand delivery of branch services such as cash delivery, check deposits, and debit card issuance. These services are delivered via proprietary digital platforms and apps.

products.name: Darovasertib Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: An oral, potent and selective small molecule inhibitor of protein kinase C (PKC) developed for the treatment of uveal melanoma (UM) across metastatic, neoadjuvant, and adjuvant settings. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug, with clinical trials supporting its use as monotherapy and in combination with other agents.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) for Solid Tumors
products.description: A pipeline of antibody-drug conjugates, including DLL3 TOP1 ADC (IDE849) and B7H3/PTK7 bispecific TOP1 ADC (IDE034), designed for targeted delivery of cytotoxic agents to tumor cells in solid tumors such as small-cell lung cancer and neuroendocrine carcinomas. These are biologically manufactured and administered intravenously.

products.name: DNA Damage Response (DDR) Pathway Inhibitors
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors targeting the DNA damage response pathway, including PARG inhibitor (IDE161) and Pol Theta inhibitor (IDE705), developed for use as monotherapies or in combination with ADCs to enhance anti-tumor activity in solid tumors. These are chemically synthesized and administered orally.

products.name: MAT2A and PRMT5 Inhibitors for MTAP-Deleted Tumors
products.description: Oral small molecule inhibitors targeting the MAT2A (IDE397) and PRMT5 (IDE892) enzymes, designed for the treatment of solid tumors with MTAP gene deletions. These are manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered orally, often used in rational combinations to exploit synthetic lethal vulnerabilities.

products.name: Next Generation Synthetic Lethality Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A pipeline of oral small molecule drugs targeting novel synthetic lethality pathways, including dual KAT6/7 inhibitor (IDE574) and WRN helicase inhibitor (IDE275), aimed at overcoming tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance in various solid tumors. These are developed through advanced drug discovery platforms and administered orally.

products.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa Phage Therapeutics
products.description: High-purity, multi-phage cocktails (e.g., AP-PA02, AP-PA03) developed using proprietary bacteriophage-based technology to treat chronic and acute P. aeruginosa infections, including cystic fibrosis, non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis, and ventilator-associated pneumonia. Manufactured as sterile liquid formulations for inhaled or intravenous administration under cGMP conditions.

products.name: Staphylococcus aureus Phage Therapeutics
products.description: Sterile, high-purity phage cocktails (e.g., AP-SA02) designed to treat complicated S. aureus infections, including bacteremia, prosthetic joint infections, and wound infections. Delivered intravenously or intra-articularly, these products are manufactured using proprietary cGMP processes for clinical and potential commercial use.

products.name: Advanced Semiconductor Packaging Services
products.description: Design, development, and high-volume manufacturing of advanced semiconductor packaging solutions, including flip chip, wafer-level, and system-in-package (SiP) modules, delivered through specialized manufacturing facilities and advanced process technologies.

products.name: Mainstream Semiconductor Packaging Services
products.description: Provision of mainstream packaging services using wirebond interconnect technology, including leadframe packages, substrate-based wirebond packages, and micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) packages, produced in high-volume manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Semiconductor Test Services
products.description: Comprehensive semiconductor test services, including wafer level, package level, burn-in, system level, and test development, provided as both interim and final quality assurance steps, leveraging co-located and geographically diverse facilities.

products.name: Dermatology Products
products.description: A range of prescription, over-the-counter, and office-dispense dermatology products based on stabilized hypochlorous acid (HOCl) for the treatment of skin conditions such as redness, irritation, scars, eczema/atopic dermatitis, acne, and post-procedure care. These products are manufactured at the company's facility and distributed globally through direct sales and partners.

products.name: Wound Care Products
products.description: HOCl-based wound care solutions and hydrogels for the treatment of acute and chronic wounds, burns, surgical irrigation, and negative pressure wound therapy. Products are manufactured in-house and sold to hospitals, clinics, and through distributors worldwide.

products.name: Eye Care Products
products.description: Prescription and over-the-counter HOCl-based solutions for eyelid and eyelash hygiene, targeting conditions such as blepharitis, dry eye, and inflammation. Products are sold directly, online, and through distributors in the U.S. and internationally.

products.name: Oral, Dental, and Nasal Care Products
products.description: HOCl-based oral rinses and nasal irrigation solutions for the treatment of mouth and throat infections, thrush, and sinus conditions. These are manufactured by the company and distributed internationally through partners.

products.name: Podiatry Products
products.description: HOCl-based wound care and daily foot care products for the management of diabetic foot ulcers, foot odors, infections, and irritations. Products are sold directly to podiatrists, hospitals, and consumers, and through distributors.

products.name: Animal Health Care Products
products.description: HOCl-based topical solutions for cleaning, debriding, and treating animal wounds and infections, marketed under MicrocynAH and MicrocynVS brands. Products are distributed through partners to pet stores, farm animal specialty stores, and veterinary clinics globally.

products.name: Surface Disinfectants
products.description: HOCl-based disinfectant and sanitizer solutions (e.g., Nanocyn) for hard surfaces and air, used in hospitals and other environments to control infectious diseases. Products are manufactured by the company and sold through partners in multiple countries.

products.name: Entertainment Retail Products and Services
products.description: Retail sale and trade of new and pre-owned movies, video games, music, books, comics, toys, and collectibles, as well as related services such as rentals, special orders, and hardware repair, delivered through physical stores and an e-commerce platform.

products.name: Retail Flooring, Cabinets, and Countertops
products.description: Retail sale and installation of flooring (hardwood, laminate, vinyl), carpeting, cabinets, and countertops to consumers, builders, and contractors, delivered through warehouse-format stores, design centers, and an e-commerce platform.

products.name: Manufactured Flooring Products
products.description: Manufacturing and sale of carpets, rugs, luxury vinyl, laminate, engineered hardwood flooring, and specialty printed carpets for residential, commercial, and hospitality markets, produced in vertically integrated facilities and distributed to dealers, home centers, and commercial end-users.

products.name: Tool and Die Steel Products
products.description: Manufacturing and distribution of pre-finished de-carb-free tool and die steel products, including alloy plate, tool steel plate, precision ground flat stock, and drill rod, supplied to steel distributors and service centers for use in tooling and manufacturing industries.

products.name: Industrial Knives and Wear Products
products.description: Manufacturing and sale of industrial knives, blades, and hardened wear products for the tissue, paper, and metals industries, including custom and replacement parts, produced with in-house grinding, machining, and heat-treating capabilities.

products.name: Metal Stampings and Assemblies
products.description: Manufacturing and supply of highly engineered metal stampings and stamped part assemblies for the appliance and automotive industries, including structural and decorative components, produced using custom tooling and powder coating processes.

products.name: Fabricated Metal Infrastructure Products
products.description: Manufacturing and distribution of specialized fabricated metal products for data centers and communication infrastructure, including cable racks, auxiliary framing, hardware, insulation products, and network bays, tailored for engineering and installation firms in the telecom industry.

products.name: Video Sharing and Livestreaming Platform
products.description: A digital platform (Rumble.com and Locals.com) offering free and subscription-based video sharing, livestreaming, and on-demand video content, accessible via web, mobile, and connected TV apps. Delivered through proprietary software and cloud infrastructure, it enables creators to upload, share, and monetize content, while users can watch, subscribe, and interact.

products.name: Livestreaming and Creator Monetization Tools
products.description: A multi-platform livestreaming and monetization service (Rumble Studio) that allows creators to broadcast live across multiple platforms, customize streams, and access monetization features such as host-read ads and sponsorships. Delivered as a web and mobile application, it integrates with the main video platform.

products.name: Advertising Marketplace and Network
products.description: A proprietary advertising marketplace (Rumble Advertising Center) that connects advertisers with inventory on Rumble.com and partner publishers, offering display, video, and sponsorship ad formats. Delivered as a self-serve digital platform, it facilitates campaign creation, bidding, and targeting for advertisers.

products.name: Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet for Creator Payments
products.description: A digital, non-custodial crypto wallet (Rumble Wallet) integrated into the Rumble platform, supporting multiple cryptocurrencies and enabling direct, borderless tipping and payments from audiences to creators. Delivered as a software feature within the main platform, it bypasses traditional payment intermediaries.

products.name: Cloud Infrastructure Services (IaaS)
products.description: A subscription-based Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offering (Rumble Cloud) providing compute, storage, security, networking, and orchestration services to businesses, governments, and enterprises. Delivered via proprietary data centers and cloud software, it includes virtual machines, storage, and private cloud solutions.

products.name: AI Infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service
products.description: A planned cloud-based AI infrastructure service offering GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS) and data center services, leveraging a large fleet of Nvidia GPUs and globally distributed data centers. Delivered to enterprise and business clients for high-performance computing and AI workloads.

products.name: Government Program Operations and Administration Services
products.description: Comprehensive business process services for government health and human services programs, including eligibility and enrollment, outreach, beneficiary education, and program administration. Delivered via contact centers, mail-room operations, and digital platforms, primarily for U.S. federal, state, and international government clients.

products.name: Clinical Assessment and Disability Evaluation Services
products.description: Clinical services including medical disability examinations, independent health and disability assessments, appeals, and person-centered eligibility assessments for government benefit programs. Delivered through a network of clinicians and digital tools, primarily for U.S. federal, state, and international agencies.

products.name: Technology Modernization and Digital Solutions for Government
products.description: Technology services for government agencies, including application development and modernization, enterprise business solutions, AI and advanced analytics, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and data management. Delivered via digital platforms, automation, and consulting, supporting modernization and efficiency.

products.name: Employment and Workforce Services
products.description: Employment services for government programs, including eligibility support, case management, job-readiness preparation, job search and employer outreach, job retention, career advancement, and vocational training. Delivered through in-person and digital channels for U.S. and international government clients.

products.name: Customer Contact Center and Citizen Engagement Services
products.description: Operation of centralized, multilingual, AI-enabled customer contact centers and digital self-service platforms to support government programs, including health insurance marketplaces, Medicare, and other public services. Delivered via phone, web, and mobile channels.

products.name: Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) and Quality Assurance Services
products.description: Independent verification and validation, quality assurance, and audit preparation services for government technology systems and program operations. Delivered through objective testing, policy reviews, and compliance audits for state and local government clients.

products.name: Specialized Financial and Tax Benefit Services
products.description: Specialized services including financial services, cost allocation plans, business process assessment and design, and assistance to commercial customers in claiming workforce and location-based tax benefits. Delivered through consulting and administrative support.

products.name: Health Care Administration Software and Technology Services (International)
products.description: Provision of health care administration software and technology services for international government clients, supporting health and disability assessments and program administration. Delivered as software solutions and digital platforms.

products.name: Abuse-Deterrent Transdermal Pharmaceutical Products (AVERSA Platform)
products.description: Development and commercialization of transdermal pharmaceutical patches incorporating proprietary AVERSA abuse-deterrent technology, designed to deter abuse, misuse, and accidental exposure of drugs such as opioids and stimulants. These products are manufactured using regulated pharmaceutical processes and require FDA approval.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services for Health, Wellness, and Over-the-Counter Pharmaceutical Products
products.description: Provision of contract manufacturing services for external customers in the health, wellness, and over-the-counter pharmaceutical sectors, utilizing specialized facilities and equipment to produce topical and transdermal products under regulatory compliance.

products.name: Contract Research and Development Services for Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Companies
products.description: Provision of contract research and development services, including early-stage drug and device clinical and preclinical studies, as well as clinical-regulatory and formulation/analytical consulting, for external pharmaceutical and medical device clients.

products.name: Metal Coating Solutions
products.description: Provides corrosion protection and lifecycle extension for fabricated steel and other metals through hot-dip galvanizing, spin galvanizing, powder coating, anodizing, and plating. Delivered via a network of manufacturing plants across North America, requiring physical manufacturing and regulated processes.

products.name: Coil Coating Solutions
products.description: Applies protective and decorative coatings to steel and aluminum coils using a process that includes cleaning, treating, painting, and curing flat metal before fabrication. Delivered through specialized coil coating plants, emphasizing efficiency, sustainability, and enhanced product performance.

products.name: Industrial Lighting Products
products.description: Designs and manufactures explosion proof and hazardous duty lighting products for industrial and electrical infrastructure applications, supporting safe and reliable power transmission. Delivered as physical products to critical infrastructure markets worldwide.

products.name: Automated Weld Overlay Solutions
products.description: Provides automated weld overlay services for corrosion and erosion mitigation, extending the lifecycle of power generation, refining, and industrial infrastructure. Delivered as specialized field or plant-based services using advanced welding technology.

products.name: GigaCloud Marketplace (B2B Ecommerce Platform)
products.description: A global B2B ecommerce platform for large parcel merchandise, primarily furniture, home appliances, and fitness equipment, connecting manufacturers (mainly in Asia) with resellers (mainly in the U.S., Europe, and Japan). The platform integrates product discovery, payments, and logistics, and is delivered digitally with physical fulfillment via a proprietary logistics network.

products.name: 1P Product Sales (Direct Inventory Sales)
products.description: Sale of company-owned inventory, primarily large parcel products such as furniture, home appliances, and fitness equipment, through the GigaCloud Marketplace and third-party ecommerce websites. Products are sourced from manufacturers and distributed via the company's fulfillment and logistics network.

products.name: Third-Party Logistics and Fulfillment Services
products.description: Provision of logistics services including ocean transportation, drayage, warehousing, packaging, and last-mile delivery for large parcel products, primarily for transactions on the GigaCloud Marketplace, but also offered to external customers when excess capacity is available. Services are delivered via a network of fulfillment centers and partnerships with shipping and trucking providers.

products.name: Branding-as-a-Service (BaaS)
products.description: A service allowing selected sellers on the GigaCloud Marketplace to sell products under established brands (e.g., Christopher Knight Home) for a designated fee. This is a digital service layered on top of the marketplace, enabling brand licensing and distribution.

products.name: Digital Catalog and Interactive Signage SaaS
products.description: Cloud-based software services for interactive digital signage and e-catalog management, enabling suppliers and sellers to display their product ranges in physical retail environments. Delivered as SaaS following the acquisition of Wonder.

products.name: Sales Analytics and Data Services
products.description: Provision of sales analytics and predictive tools to sellers for a fee, leveraging proprietary data and AI to help sellers manage inventory, pricing, and sales forecasts. Delivered digitally as a value-added service to marketplace participants.

products.name: Automotive Aftermarket Replacement Parts
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of premium replacement parts for the automotive aftermarket, including engine management, electrical and safety, wire sets, temperature control, engine cooling, air conditioning, and engine efficiency components. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Custom-Engineered Solutions for Vehicle and Equipment Manufacturers
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacture of custom-engineered solutions and components for original equipment manufacturers and their suppliers in markets such as commercial and light vehicles, construction, agriculture, power sports, marine, hydraulics, and lawn and garden. Delivered through physical manufacturing and technical collaboration.

products.name: Thermal Management Products
products.description: Manufacture and supply of thermal management products, including AC system components, engine cooling, heat exchangers, compressors, and related electronics for both aftermarket and OEM customers. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Sensors and Switches
products.description: Design and manufacture of a wide range of sensors (speed, position, temperature, pressure, level, particulate matter) and switches for vehicle and equipment applications, sold to both aftermarket and OEM customers. Products are physically manufactured and integrated into vehicle systems.

products.name: Power Distribution and Electrification Components
products.description: Manufacture of power distribution products (power switching, industrial solenoids, voltage regulators) and electrification/electronics (CAN devices, wiring, electronic controls) for vehicles and equipment, serving both aftermarket and OEM customers. Products are physically manufactured and supplied globally.

products.name: Injection, Fuel Delivery, Ignition & Emissions Components
products.description: Production and supply of injection and fuel delivery systems (for gasoline, diesel, and alternative fuels), ignition coils, wire sets, and emissions control components for vehicles and equipment. Products are physically manufactured and distributed to aftermarket and OEM customers.

products.name: Clamping Devices
products.description: Manufacture and supply of clamping devices for commercial and light vehicle automotive and industrial applications, delivered as physical components to OEM and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Plinabulin Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: A first-in-class, small molecule immunomodulating microtubule-binding agent developed and manufactured for use as an anti-cancer therapy, primarily in combination with chemotherapy, immuno-oncology agents, and radiation for advanced and metastatic solid tumors such as NSCLC, SCLC, and other cancers. Delivered via infusion, it is produced through chemical synthesis and requires regulated clinical development and manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Plinabulin for Chemotherapy-Induced Neutropenia (CIN) Prevention
products.description: Plinabulin, as a small molecule drug, is developed and manufactured for the prevention of chemotherapy-induced neutropenia, either as monotherapy or in combination with G-CSF agents. It is administered to cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy to reduce the incidence and severity of neutropenia, requiring pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical infrastructure.

products.name: Plinabulin Combination Immuno-Oncology Regimens
products.description: Combination regimens using Plinabulin with immuno-oncology agents (such as PD-1/PD-L1 and CTLA-4 antibodies), chemotherapy, and/or radiation, developed for patients with advanced cancers, especially those progressed on checkpoint inhibitors. These regimens are delivered through clinical protocols and require pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulated clinical trial infrastructure.

products.name: Targeted Protein Degradation (TPD) Therapeutics (via SEED Therapeutics)
products.description: Novel small molecule therapeutics developed using SEED’s proprietary Targeted Protein Degradation (TPD) platform, including molecular glue degraders targeting previously undruggable proteins for oncology, neurodegeneration, immunology, and antiviral indications. These are produced through advanced drug discovery, chemical synthesis, and require regulated clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: Early-Stage Small Molecule Immuno-Oncology Agents (BPI-002, BPI-003, BPI-004)
products.description: A pipeline of preclinical small molecule agents (BPI-002, BPI-003, BPI-004) designed to modulate immune responses or tumor antigenicity for cancer therapy. These are developed through chemical synthesis and preclinical research, with future plans for clinical development and manufacturing.

products.name: Imaging Systems
products.description: Manufactures and sells advanced medical imaging devices including molecular imaging, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance (MR), women's health imaging, and X-ray systems. These are physical devices installed in hospitals and clinics, often supported by AI-enabled software and digital applications.

products.name: Ultrasound and Advanced Visualization Solutions
products.description: Designs and sells specialized ultrasound systems for comprehensive care, women's health, cardiovascular, interventional, and surgical guidance, including mobile and handheld devices. These are physical devices enhanced with digital, AI, and workflow automation software.

products.name: Patient Monitoring and Life Support Solutions
products.description: Provides a range of patient monitoring devices, diagnostic cardiology equipment (e.g., ECG), maternal infant care products, anesthesia and ventilation systems, and related consumables. These are physical devices and accessories used in hospitals and clinics, often integrated with digital and AI-enabled solutions.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (Contrast Media and Radiopharmaceuticals)
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and distributes contrast media and radiopharmaceutical imaging agents used in diagnostic imaging procedures (CT, MR, X-ray, ultrasound, SPECT, PET). These are regulated pharmaceutical products requiring specialized manufacturing and supply chain.

products.name: Healthcare Digital and AI Solutions
products.description: Offers AI-enabled, cloud-based, and software solutions for clinical decision support, workflow automation, data integration, and operational efficiency. These are digital-only products, often sold as software-as-a-service (SaaS), interoperable with various medical devices and hospital IT systems.

products.name: Healthcare Equipment and Software Service Solutions
products.description: Provides maintenance, repair, upgrade, and lifecycle management services for medical equipment and software, including preventative maintenance, onsite engineering, and system upgrades. These services are delivered by field engineers and digital platforms, supporting both GE and non-GE installed bases.

products.name: Cloud Video Surveillance
products.description: A cloud-native video surveillance platform enhanced with AI/ML analytics for automated event detection, anomaly recognition, and real-time alerts. Delivered as a SaaS solution, it integrates with existing or new cameras and provides secure offsite storage, browser-based access, and advanced search capabilities.

products.name: Remote Guarding Services
products.description: A 24/7 live remote security monitoring service where trained security personnel, supported by AI analytics, review alerts, intervene in real time via networked speakers, and escalate incidents as needed. Delivered through a cloud-based platform, it reduces reliance on on-site guards and enables proactive crime prevention.

products.name: Remote Guarding Software Platform
products.description: A cloud-native orchestration platform that connects cameras, AI analytics, and human operators, enabling incident triage, standardized response playbooks, and auditable records. It centralizes security operations and integrates with both Cloudastructure's and customer-provided guards.

products.name: Operational Intelligence Dashboards
products.description: Centralized dashboards and reporting tools for property managers and enterprise security teams, providing real-time alerts, analytics, and workflow management to drive informed decision-making and align security operations with risk management strategies. Delivered digitally as part of the cloud platform.

products.name: Cloud Video Recorder (CVR) Devices
products.description: An IoT hardware device that collects video from cameras and transmits it securely to the cloud, compatible with most cameras, and capable of local storage during internet outages. Sold as a physical product to enable cloud video surveillance integration.

products.name: Networked Cameras and Speakers
products.description: Resale of IP-based cameras and networked speakers, which are installed at customer sites to enable video capture and two-way audio for surveillance and remote intervention. Sold as hardware, often bundled with installation services.

products.name: Mobile Surveillance Trailer Solutions
products.description: Solar and battery powered portable surveillance towers equipped with wireless broadband, cameras, and speakers, providing rapid deployment of video surveillance and remote guarding capabilities in remote or temporary locations. Includes versions with integrated drones for expanded coverage.

products.name: Solar Powered Surveillance Enclosures
products.description: Solar-powered enclosures that enable surveillance in remote locations without grid power or internet, using edge-enabled connectivity to stream video securely to the cloud. Sold as hardware for specialized deployment scenarios.

products.name: Nutraceutical Supplements (Kirkman Brand)
products.description: Manufactured and distributed dietary supplements including probiotics, enzymes, vitamins, multivitamins, amino acids, antioxidants, immune support, essential fatty acids, and specialty products. Produced in a cGMP certified, FDA-registered facility and sold over-the-counter through various channels to consumers and professionals globally.

products.name: Certified Prenatal Vitamins (P2i by Kirkman)
products.description: Specially formulated and independently certified prenatal vitamins for expectant mothers, produced to meet stringent low-toxicity standards and tested for contaminants. Manufactured in compliance with international guidelines and distributed primarily in the US with plans for global expansion.

products.name: Digital Health & Wellness Platform (Tru2u.health)
products.description: A consumer-facing digital platform offering telehealth consultations, personalized treatment plans, medication-based wellness protocols (including GLP-1 weight management), and integrated sales of proprietary supplements. Delivered via virtual clinical support and compliant digital workflows in partnership with CareValidate.

products.name: Tru2u Branded Supplements
products.description: A line of 10 science-backed nutritional supplements (e.g., multivitamin, biotin, B complex, magnesium/melatonin, vitamin D, CoQ10, L-theanine, phosphatidylserine, bone support, vitamin C) sold under the Tru2u brand, manufactured using existing formulations and integrated into the Tru2u.health platform.

products.name: Plant-Based Beverages
products.description: Manufactured plant-based milks including oat, almond, soy, coconut, and rice, produced in specialized processing facilities using Tetra Pak packaging and distributed through retail, club, foodservice, and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Broths
products.description: Production and distribution of shelf-stable broths, utilizing in-house processing and packaging capabilities, primarily for retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Better-For-You Snacks
products.description: Manufacture and supply of non-GMO, organic, and gluten-free snack products, distributed through multiple channels including retail and foodservice.

products.name: Liquid Ingredients
products.description: Production of liquid food ingredients, such as fruit and plant-based concentrates, for sale to other food and beverage manufacturers, using industrial-scale processing facilities.

products.name: Private Label and Co-Manufacturing Services
products.description: Provision of private label and contract manufacturing services for beverages, broths, and snacks, leveraging in-house innovation, processing, and packaging infrastructure for external brands and retailers.

products.name: Branded Consumer Products
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and marketing of proprietary branded food and beverage products under owned trademarks, distributed through retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Online Cannabis Marketplace (Weedmaps)
products.description: A digital platform accessible via website and mobile apps that allows cannabis consumers to search, browse, and reserve cannabis products from licensed retailers and brands. The marketplace aggregates product, pricing, and retailer data, and facilitates product discovery, education, and order-ahead for pickup or delivery, but does not process payments or fulfill orders directly.

products.name: eCommerce and Compliance Software Suite (Weedmaps for Business)
products.description: A subscription-based, cloud-delivered Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform for cannabis retailers and brands, offering integrated tools for compliance, inventory management, order management, menu management, POS integration, analytics, and customer engagement. Delivered digitally and designed to streamline front and back-end operations in compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Digital Advertising Solutions (WM Ads, Featured Listings, Banner Ads, WM Deals)
products.description: A suite of digital advertising products for cannabis businesses, including premium placement listings, banner ads, promotion tiles, and discount tools, all delivered through the Weedmaps marketplace and associated digital surfaces. These solutions are designed to amplify client visibility and reach targeted cannabis consumers.

products.name: Logistics and Delivery Management Software (WM Dispatch)
products.description: A cloud-based software solution, including driver apps, that enables cannabis retailers and delivery operators to manage, automate, and optimize last-mile delivery logistics in compliance with regulations. The product streamlines the delivery process from in-store to front-door.

products.name: Data Analytics and Insights Platform (WM Insights)
products.description: A digital analytics platform providing cannabis businesses with data-driven insights on user engagement, traffic trends, product and brand rankings, and market trends, leveraging first-party data from the Weedmaps ecosystem. Delivered as part of the SaaS suite or as an add-on.

products.name: Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System
products.description: A disposable, percutaneous, needle electrode system used with the nPulse Console for nonthermal ablation of soft tissue in surgical procedures, including treatment of benign thyroid nodules. Requires physical manufacturing, regulatory clearance, and is delivered via in-person medical procedures.

products.name: nPulse Cardiac Surgical Clamp System
products.description: A surgical ablation clamp system utilizing nsPFA technology for the treatment of atrial fibrillation during cardiac surgery. Requires physical manufacturing, regulatory approval, and is used by cardiac surgeons in operating rooms.

products.name: nPulse Cardiac Catheter System
products.description: An endocardial catheter ablation device using nsPFA technology for minimally invasive treatment of atrial fibrillation. Requires physical manufacturing, clinical validation, and is delivered by electrophysiologists in catheterization labs.

products.name: nPulse System Platform (Console and Applicators)
products.description: A tunable, software-enabled medical device platform (console) designed to deliver nsPFA energy via various disposable applicators for multiple clinical applications, including soft tissue and cardiac ablation. Requires regulated manufacturing and is sold to healthcare providers for use in conjunction with company electrodes and catheters.

products.name: AI/ML Analytics Platform (bfLEAP™)
products.description: A proprietary artificial intelligence and machine learning platform for advanced analysis of preclinical and clinical data, enabling drug discovery, target identification, and clinical trial optimization. Delivered as a digital analytics service to biopharmaceutical companies and research organizations.

products.name: AI-Powered Bioinformatics and Data Integration Solutions (BullFrog Data Networks™)
products.description: A digital bioinformatics solution that integrates and analyzes multi-omics, clinical, and real-world biomedical data to uncover biological relationships and generate insights for drug discovery and clinical trial design. Delivered as a software and analytics service to life sciences organizations.

products.name: AI-Powered Data Preparation Platform (bfPREP™)
products.description: A digital platform that cleans, standardizes, and harmonizes fragmented biomedical datasets (clinical, omics, real-world data) to produce analysis-ready data for drug discovery and clinical research. Offered as a software tool or service to life sciences organizations.

products.name: Scenario-Based Decision Engine for Drug Development
products.description: An AI-powered analytical environment that applies advanced modeling and simulation to evaluate multiple drug development scenarios, supporting portfolio prioritization, clinical trial design, and strategic planning for life sciences organizations. Delivered as a digital analytics solution.

products.name: Contract AI/ML Data Analysis Services for Drug Development
products.description: Fee-for-service analytical services using proprietary AI/ML platforms to analyze large, complex biomedical data sets for biopharmaceutical companies and organizations at various stages of drug development. Delivered as a professional service, sometimes including equity or IP rights.

products.name: Collaborative Drug Development and Asset Rescue Partnerships
products.description: Collaborative arrangements with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies to apply AI/ML analytics to drugs in development or failed clinical trials, with revenue from service fees, success fees, and milestone payments. Includes joint development and commercialization of rescued drug assets.

products.name: Acquisition, Development, and Divestiture of Drug Assets
products.description: Acquisition of rights to preclinical, clinical-stage, or failed drugs, application of proprietary AI/ML analytics to identify responder populations, conducting clinical trials, and divesting or licensing the enhanced drug assets to pharmaceutical companies. Involves physical drug development and clinical research.

products.name: siRNA Therapeutics Targeting Beta2-spectrin
products.description: A preclinical small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutic targeting Beta2-spectrin for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma, obesity, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Developed through licensed technology and intended for clinical development and out-licensing.

products.name: Improved Formulations and Prodrugs of Mebendazole for Oncology
products.description: Proprietary improved formulations and prodrugs of mebendazole for the treatment of glioblastoma and other cancers, developed through exclusive licenses and currently in preclinical and early clinical stages. Involves physical drug manufacturing, clinical trials, and potential out-licensing.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides secured and unsecured loans to businesses, including owner-occupied commercial real estate, income-producing property, equipment finance, operating loans, SBA/USDA loans, builder finance, renewable energy, and asset-based lending. Delivered through local branches and specialized units, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans, primarily secured by personal residences, including home equity and other personal loans. Delivered through branches and digital channels, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending and Servicing
products.description: Originates and services fixed and adjustable-rate home mortgages for purchase and refinancing, with a significant portion sold into the secondary market. Delivered via retail mortgage division, requiring regulatory approval and compliance with Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac standards.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit products including checking, savings, money market, and other deposit accounts to individuals and businesses. Delivered through branches, offices, internet, and mobile applications, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provides private banking, investment management, investment advice, and financial planning services, including estate and retirement planning. Delivered through dedicated wealth management division, utilizing open architecture for asset management and requiring licensed professionals.

products.name: Trust Services
products.description: Offers trust services to manage fiduciary assets for clients, including estate and retirement planning. Delivered by specialized professionals and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Sells insurance products such as life, long-term care, tax-deferred annuities, and property insurance, both directly and through an independent insurance agency. Delivered via licensed agents and partnerships, requiring state insurance licensing and compliance.

products.name: Payment and Merchant Services
products.description: Provides payment processing and merchant services, including debit card processing and payment solutions for commercial and small business customers. Delivered through joint ventures and partnerships, requiring technology infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equipment Finance and Related Reinsurance
products.description: Offers equipment financing to businesses nationwide and provides reinsurance on property insurance contracts covering financed equipment. Delivered through specialized subsidiaries, requiring financial capital and insurance expertise.

products.name: Billboard Advertising
products.description: Rental of advertising space on static and digital billboards, including bulletins and posters, which are manufactured, installed, and maintained by the company on owned or leased sites across the U.S. and Canada. Digital billboards use LED technology to display rotating digital ads.

products.name: Logo Sign Advertising
products.description: Rental of advertising space on logo signs and tourist oriented directional signs located near highway exits, primarily advertising nearby services such as gas, food, lodging, and attractions. The company constructs, installs, and maintains these signs under exclusive state contracts.

products.name: Transit Advertising
products.description: Rental of advertising space on the exterior and interior of public transportation vehicles, in airport terminals, and on transit shelters and benches. The company installs and maintains these displays under contracts with municipalities and airport authorities.

products.name: Programmatic Digital Out-of-Home Advertising
products.description: Sale of digital advertising inventory through programmatic partners, allowing advertisers to purchase digital billboard space across multiple channels via automated platforms. This is a digital-only, technology-driven service leveraging unsold digital display inventory.

products.name: Plumbing Services
products.description: Comprehensive plumbing installation, repair, and maintenance services for residential and commercial customers, delivered through skilled trades personnel at customer locations.

products.name: Electric Motor Solutions
products.description: Industrial-scale electric motor maintenance, repair, testing, and new motor sales, primarily for midstream natural gas pipeline operators and utilities, delivered via field and in-shop services.

products.name: Professional Finance and HR Services
products.description: Outsourced finance, accounting, technical accounting, human resources, and advisory services, delivered by experienced professionals on a project, fractional, or interim basis to business clients.

products.name: IT Managed Services and Equipment Sales
products.description: Comprehensive IT managed services including equipment sales, service and maintenance, and helpdesk support, delivered to business clients primarily in select U.S. states.

products.name: Healthcare Staffing Services
products.description: Temporary and per diem healthcare staffing services, primarily registered nurses and allied professionals, provided to hospitals and healthcare facilities on a contract basis.

products.name: Cardiac Telemetry Monitoring Services
products.description: Outsourced 24/7 cardiac telemetry monitoring services for hospitals, utilizing remote connectivity to hospital telemetry systems and mobile monitors for patient care.

products.name: Shared-Ownership Property Management Software
products.description: Vertical market software products designed to manage all types of shared-ownership properties, delivered as business-to-business software solutions globally.

products.name: Automotive Vehicle Service Agreements (Extended Warranties)
products.description: Marketing, sale, and administration of vehicle service agreements (extended warranties) for new and used automobiles, motorcycles, and ATVs, covering repair or replacement of vehicle parts for a specified term, distributed via credit unions and dealerships.

products.name: HVAC and Equipment Warranty Products and Maintenance Services
products.description: Sale and administration of warranty products for HVAC, standby generators, commercial LED lighting, and refrigeration equipment, as well as provision of equipment breakdown and maintenance support services, delivered through partnerships with manufacturers, distributors, and service providers.
